<img decoding="async" class="nohover alignnone" src="https://thebreakers.b-cdn.net/wp-content/themes/enfold-child/images/sep.png" alt="Seperator" /></h3>
<p class="" data-start="697" data-end="1000">Our <strong data-start="717" data-end="742">173 comfortable rooms</strong> provide everything you need for a <strong data-start="777" data-end="805">relaxed start to the day</strong>: <strong data-start="807" data-end="894">cozy beds with extra-long duvets, spacious showers, plenty of light, and free Wi-Fi</strong>. Every room has a <strong data-start="913" data-end="932">private balcony</strong> and was newly renovated in early 2023 in a <strong data-start="976" data-end="997">modern boho style</strong>.</p>
<p class="" data-start="1002" data-end="1264">For those looking for extra space and a special atmosphere, our <strong data-start="1066" data-end="1088">XL Lifestyle Rooms</strong> are the perfect choice. These six exclusive rooms feature a <strong data-start="1149" data-end="1173">freestanding bathtub</strong> with stunning sunrise or sunset views – creating an unforgettable relaxation experience.</p>

</div></div></div></div></div><div id='rates' class='avia-section av-3db66wo-0bb48365387c37a7a8d0d09dbdf0c335 main_color avia-section-default avia-no-border-styling avia-builder-el-77 el_after_av_section avia-builder-el-last avia-bg-style-scroll container_wrap fullsize' ><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><div class='template-page content av-content-full alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-1960'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'>
<div class='flex_column av-3ccmme0-c67436e20ca690da6155eebe6715381f av_two_fifth avia-builder-el-78 el_before_av_three_fifth avia-builder-el-first first flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding ' ><section class='av_textblock_section av-3aiqsl4-683ce404d5c31c11a98d69201639f9ad ' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><h3>RATES</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Rates, Payment &#038; Cancellation Policy</strong><br />
All mentioned rates are on half board basis, per person per night. To guarantee your reservation, we will need a prepayment of Euro 200,00 per room. A payment link will be sent to you. Please don’t pay before receiving the link. Bank charges to be covered by the guest. Compulsory fee for Christmas (24.12.2026): 96.00 € per person. Compulsory fee for New Year’s Eve (31.12.2026): 154.00 € per person.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><strong>Kids Policy</strong><br />
Maximum 01 child from ages 0 to 5.99 free of charge sharing parents’ room on existing bedding at the same meal plan booked. No extra beds possible (except one baby bed for kids up to 1,99 years).</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><strong>Method of Payment</strong><br />
You have the possibility to pay either in cash or by credit card (Visa / Mastercard).</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><strong>Cancellation Policy</strong><br />
If canceled up to 14 days before date of arrival, no fee will be charged.<br />
If canceled later, the following will be charged:<br />
From the 14th day befor the start of the service, 150,00€ will be retained in the event of a cancellation.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><strong>Cancellation at short notice and no-show</strong><br />
For cancellations from the 7th day before the start of the service or in the event of non-commencement of the trip or use of the service, 200,00€ will be charged.</li>
</ul>
<p>The date of receipt of the cancellation notice by the hotel is decisive for the deadline.<br />
The guest may provide evidence that no or less damage has occurred.</p>
<ul>
<li>Rates <a href="https://travel.orca-diveclubs.com/basis/161/?lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Orca Dive Club</strong></a></li>
<li>Rates <a href="https://kitehouse.somabay.com/kitesurfing/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>7 Bft KiteHouse</strong></a></li>
<li>For further information contact us directly at: <strong><a href="m&#97;&#x69;&#x6c;t&#111;&#x3a;&#x69;n&#102;&#x6f;&#x40;t&#104;&#x65;&#x62;r&#101;&#x61;&#x6b;e&#114;&#115;&#x2d;&#x73;o&#109;&#x61;&#x62;a&#121;&#x2e;&#x63;o&#109;"> &#x69;&#x6e;&#102;o&#x40;&#x74;&#104;eb&#x72;&#x65;&#97;k&#x65;&#x72;&#115;&#45;s&#x6f;&#x6d;&#97;b&#x61;&#x79;&#46;&#99;o&#x6d;</a></strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Breakers Hotel Special:</strong> <strong>20 % or 10 % discount for winter 2026/2027* </strong></p>
<p><strong>*Conditions for our Special „20 % / 10 % discount“:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>the discount will be calculated on the mentioned room rates (incl. half board)</li>
<li>the special is valid only for direct bookings / not valid for bookings through tour operators</li>
<li>arrival dates: 01.11.2026 until 30.04.2027 inclusive</li>
<li>in case of booking until latest 31.07.2026: 20 %</li>
<li>in case of booking until latest 30.09.2026: 10 %</li>
</ul>
